description: pixel art, the lower half of a lean young woman master archer in elegant black leather armour with silver plates, black leggings and tall black boots, with a long dark green cloak and a long black bow strapped upright on her back, riding: seated astride a horse that is not drawn, seen strictly from the side and facing right; the dark green cloak that ends at the bottom of the upper half continues on without a break, hanging back and down behind her over the back of the horse that is not drawn, to the level of the knee, its edge clean and outlined and well inside the picture; the hips sit on the saddle, the near thigh in black leggings lies forward along the horse's back, the near lower leg in a tall black boot hangs straight down from the knee, the boot rests level in a stirrup that is not drawn; only the near leg is seen; the same colours, outline, pixel size and shading as the upper half above, which stays as it is; nothing else: no horse, no saddle, no reins, no ground, no loose or scattered pixels, transparent background
